Definition: an idol (as fashioned); also pain (bodily or mental)
BiblicalUsage: Sorrow, or pain, names what a mother bears and what a nation suffers. Jabez was called by that name because his mother bare him with sorrow, and God promised Israel rest from their sorrow and from their fear.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sorrow is the price of a name like Jabez: his mother bore him with sorrow, and he prayed that God would keep him from it.
